pattern: serial accumulation chains and unreachable comparisons
strategy: replace serial adds with balanced trees, hardcode unreachable saturate logic
rationale: serial chain depth falls from 12 to 4 adders (sys/dsp), and from 256 to 8 XOR (aux). Comparisons that cannot fire are removed entirely.
target: sys_s accumulation, dsp_s accumulation, sys overflow detection, aux_par_chain reduction
area_cost: small — removed comparison logic, slightly fewer intermediates in carry propagation
equivalence_argument: Each tree computes the identical sum in the same width. Reset unaffected: all wires combinational. Saturation result is identical because sys_s cannot overflow SYS_LIMIT (provable from operand bounds), so always-false comparisons become the identity on sys_s. Aux parity is XOR reduction, which is associative and commutative — ^data_q is identical to the serial chain through all 256 bits.
